title: Amazing Grace
author: Aretha Franklin
lyrics_snippet: Amazing grace! How sweet the sound, that saved a wretch like me!
full_lyrics:
Amazing grace! How sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found
Was blind, but now I see.

Twas grace that taught my heart to fear
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed.

title: Take My Hand, Precious Lord
author: Mahalia Jackson
lyrics_snippet: Precious Lord, take my hand, lead me on, let me stand.
full_lyrics:
Precious Lord, take my hand
Lead me on, let me stand
I am tired, I am weak, I am worn
Through the storm, through the night
Lead me on to the light
Take my hand, precious Lord, lead me home.

title: Oh Happy Day
author: The Edwin Hawkins Singers
album: Let Us Go Into the House of the Lord
lyrics_snippet: Oh happy day, when Jesus washed my sins away!
full_lyrics:
Oh happy day (Oh happy day)
When Jesus washed (When Jesus washed)
When Jesus washed (When Jesus washed)
He washed my sins away (Oh happy day)

He taught me how to watch, fight and pray
And live rejoicing every day.

title: Stomp
author: Kirk Franklin & The Family
lyrics_snippet: I counterfeit the claim that praise must keep you quiet.
full_lyrics:
I can't stop praising His name
I can't stop praising His name
Jesus, the king of kings

G-O-D-S-P-R-O-P-E-R-T-Y
Stomp! Layout your praise, let out the sound
He lifted my feet up off the ground!

title: Shackles (Praise You)
author: Mary Mary
lyrics_snippet: Take the shackles off my feet so I can dance, I just wanna praise You.
full_lyrics:
In the corners of my mind, I just can't seem to find a reason to be blue
Cause I'm thinking of Your kindness and the things You brought me through

Take the shackles off my feet so I can dance
I just wanna praise You, I just wanna praise You
You broke the chains now I can lift my hands
And I'm gonna praise You, I'm gonna praise You.

title: Goodness of God
author: CeCe Winans
lyrics_snippet: All my life You have been faithful, all my life You have been so, so good.
full_lyrics:
I love You Lord, oh Your mercy never fails me
All my days I've been held in Your hands
From the moment that I wake up, until I lay my head
I will sing of the goodness of God

All my life You have been faithful
All my life You have been so, so good
With every breath that I am able
Oh, I will sing of the goodness of God.

title: Break Every Chain
author: Tasha Cobbs Leonard
lyrics_snippet: There is power in the name of Jesus to break every chain.
full_lyrics:
There is power in the name of Jesus
There is power in the name of Jesus
There is power in the name of Jesus
To break every chain, break every chain, break every chain

All sufficient sacrifice
So freely given for our price
To open heaven's gates wide
Breaking every chain down.

title: Total Praise
author: Richard Smallwood
lyrics_snippet: Lord, I will lift my eyes to the hills, knowing my help comes from You.
full_lyrics:
Lord, I will lift my eyes to the hills
Knowing my help is coming from You
Your peace You give me in time of the storm

You are the source of my strength
You are the strength of my life
I lift my hands in total praise to You.

title: Every Praise
author: Hezekiah Walker
lyrics_snippet: Every praise is to our God, every word of worship with one accord.
full_lyrics:
Every praise is to our God
Every word of worship with one accord
Every praise, every praise is to our God

Sing hallelujah to our God
Glory hallelujah is due our God
Every praise, every praise is to our God.

title: No Weapon
author: Fred Hammond
lyrics_snippet: No weapon formed against me shall prosper, it won't work.
full_lyrics:
No weapon formed against me shall prosper
It won't work
God will do what He said He would do
He will stand by His word and see it through

Oh, your test will become your testimony
No weapon formed against you shall prosper!

title: I Can Only Imagine
author: Tamela Mann
lyrics_snippet: I can only imagine what my eyes will see when Your face looks at me.
full_lyrics:
I can only imagine what it will be like
When I walk by Your side
I can only imagine what my eyes will see
When Your face looks at me

Surrounded by Your glory, what will my heart feel?
Will I dance for You Jesus or in awe of You be still?
I can only imagine.

title: Alabaster Box
author: CeCe Winans
lyrics_snippet: Don't be angry if I wash His feet with my tears and wipe them with my hair.
full_lyrics:
The room grew still as she made her way to Jesus
She fell down and began to weep
She poured her perfume out on Him

Don't be angry if I wash His feet with my tears
And wipe them with my hair
You weren't there when He found me
You don't know the cost of the oil in my alabaster box.

title: Jireh
author: Maverick City Music
lyrics_snippet: Jireh, You are enough! I will be content in every circumstance.
full_lyrics:
I'll never be more loved than I am right now
Wasn't holding You up, so there's nothing I can do to let You down

Jireh, You are enough
Jireh, You are enough
And I will be content in every circumstance
Jireh, You are enough!

title: Going Up Yonder
author: Tramaine Hawkins
lyrics_snippet: If you want to know where I'm going, I'm going up yonder to be with my Lord.
full_lyrics:
If you want to know
Where I'm going
Where I'm going, soon

I'm going up yonder
I'm going up yonder
I'm going up yonder
To be with my Lord.

title: The Battle Is the Lord's
author: Yolanda Adams
lyrics_snippet: There's no need to fight, for the battle is not yours, it's the Lord's.
full_lyrics:
Why are you hurting, why are you crying
There is a savior who sees your tears

There's no need to fight, hold your head high
The battle is not yours, it belongs to the Lord
He will step in, give you peace within
The battle is the Lord's.

title: Intentional
author: Travis Greene
lyrics_snippet: All things are working for my good, cause He's intentional.
full_lyrics:
All things are working for my good
Cause He's intentional, He's intentional
All things are working for my good
He's intentional, never failing.

I can smile when tears are in my eyes
I can trust Him, He layout my life.

title: Made A Way
author: Travis Greene
lyrics_snippet: You made a way, when our backs were against the wall.
full_lyrics:
You made a way
When our backs were against the wall
And it looked as if it was over

You made a way
And we're standing here
Only because You made a way.

title: God Provided
author: Tamela Mann
lyrics_snippet: When I needed a shelter, God provided a safe place.
full_lyrics:
I looked back over my life
To see where my help came from
It wasn't luck, it wasn't chance
It was the Lord's strong hand

God provided, God provided
Every single time I fell, He provided
He's my shelter, my guide.

title: Something About the Name Jesus
author: Kirk Franklin
lyrics_snippet: Something about the name Jesus, it is the sweetest name I know.
full_lyrics:
Something about the name Jesus
Something about the name Jesus
It is the sweetest name I know

It soothes my doubts, calms my fears
It drives away all my tears
Oh, how I love the name Jesus.

title: Never Would Have Made It
author: Marvin Sapp
lyrics_snippet: Never would have made it, never could have made it without You.
full_lyrics:
Never would have made it
Never could have made it without You
I would have lost it all, but You held me

I'm stronger, I'm wiser, I'm better
So much better, because You kept me
Never would have made it.

title: We Fall Down
author: Donnie McClurkin
lyrics_snippet: We fall down, but we get up, for a saint is just a sinner who fell down and got up.
full_lyrics:
We fall down, but we get up
We fall down, but we get up
We fall down, but we get up
For a saint is just a sinner who fell down and got up

Goodness and mercy follow me
He forgives all my iniquity.

title: Stand
author: Donnie McClurkin
lyrics_snippet: What do you do when you've done all you can, and it seems like you can't make it through? You just stand.
full_lyrics:
What do you do when you've done all you can
And it seems like you can't make it through?
After you've done everything you can
You just stand

Stand and be confident
God has got it all under control
Just stand.

title: I Need You Now
author: Smokie Norful
lyrics_snippet: Not tomorrow, Lord, but right now, I need a blessing from You.
full_lyrics:
Not tomorrow, but right now
Lord, I need You to step into my storm
My heart is heavy, my eyes are crying

I need You now, oh I need You now
Father, touch my mind, heal my broken body
I need You right now.

title: Melodies From Heaven
author: Kirk Franklin & The Family
lyrics_snippet: Melodies from heaven, rain down on me, rain down on me.
full_lyrics:
Melodies from heaven
Rain down on me, rain down on me
Beautiful harmony
Bring me peace, set me free

Take me away to a place where praise is sweet
Let Your music rain on me.

title: For Your Glory
author: Tasha Cobbs Leonard
lyrics_snippet: Lord, I will do anything, just to see You, to behold You as my King.
full_lyrics:
Lord, I will do anything, just to see You
To behold You as my King
For Your glory, I will find a way

If I have to find favor in Your sight
To walk in Your light
Lord, for Your glory, I will cross any line.

title: Excess Love
author: Mercy Chinwo
lyrics_snippet: Your love is too much, oh! Jesus, Your love is excessive for me.
full_lyrics:
Your love is too much, oh
Your love is too much, oh
Jesus, You love me too much, oh
Your excess love, oh

You no dey use me play
You no dey carry me joke
Your love is excessive for me.

title: Way Maker
author: Sinach
lyrics_snippet: You are way maker, miracle worker, promise keeper, light in the darkness.
full_lyrics:
You are here, moving in our midst
I worship You, I worship You
You are here, working in this place

Way maker, miracle worker, promise keeper
Light in the darkness, my God
That is who You are.

title: Open the Eyes of My Heart
author: Michael W. Smith
lyrics_snippet: Open the eyes of my heart, Lord, I want to see You.
full_lyrics:
Open the eyes of my heart, Lord
Open the eyes of my heart
I want to see You
I want to see You

To see You high and lifted up
Shining in the light of Your glory
Pour out Your power and love
As we sing holy, holy, holy.

title: Agnus Dei
author: Michael W. Smith
lyrics_snippet: Alleluia, for the Lord God Almighty reigns.
full_lyrics:
Alleluia, Alleluia
For the Lord God Almighty reigns
Alleluia, Alleluia

Holy, Holy
Are You Lord God Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb, Worthy is the Lamb
You are Holy.

title: Hosanna
author: Kirk Franklin
lyrics_snippet: Hosanna, forever we praise You, King of Kings.
full_lyrics:
Hosanna, Hosanna
Hosanna to the King of Kings
Hosanna, Hosanna
Forever we praise Your name

Let the nations rise and declare Your glory
Let the choir sing a song of redemption
Hosanna in the highest.

title: Now Behold the Lamb
author: Kirk Franklin & The Family
lyrics_snippet: Now behold the Lamb, the precious Lamb of God, born of sin that I may live again.
full_lyrics:
Now behold the Lamb
The precious Lamb of God
Born of sin that I may live again
Now behold the Lamb

Holy is the Lamb
The precious Lamb of God
Why You loved me so, I'll never know
But behold the Lamb.

title: Bow Down and Worship Him
author: Paul Wilbur
lyrics_snippet: Bow down and worship Him, worship Him, oh enter in.
full_lyrics:
Bow down and worship Him
Worship Him, oh enter in
Consuming fire, sweet perfume
His awesome presence fills this room

So bow down and worship Him
For He is holy, He is the Lord.

title: Days of Elijah
author: Judy Jacobs
lyrics_snippet: These are the days of Elijah, declaring the word of the Lord.
full_lyrics:
These are the days of Elijah
Declaring the word of the Lord
And these are the days of Your servant Moses
Righteousness being restored

Behold He comes, riding on the clouds
Shining like the sun, at the trumpet call
Lift your voice, it's the year of jubilee
Out of Zion's hill salvation comes.

title: Soon and Very Soon
author: Andraé Crouch
lyrics_snippet: Soon and very soon, we are going to see the King.
full_lyrics:
Soon and very soon, we are going to see the King
Soon and very soon, we are going to see the King
Soon and very soon, we are going to see the King
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, we're going to see the King

No more crying there, we are going to see the King
No more dying there, we are going to see the King.

title: The Blood Will Never Lose Its Power
author: Andraé Crouch
lyrics_snippet: It soothes my doubts and calms my fears, and it dries all my tears. The blood will never lose its power.
full_lyrics:
The blood that Jesus shed for me
Way back on Calvary
The blood that gives me strength from day to day
It will never lose its power

For it reaches to the highest mountain
And it flows to the lowest valley
The blood that gives me strength from day to day
It will never lose its power.

title: To God Be the Glory
author: Andraé Crouch
lyrics_snippet: To God be the glory, to God be the glory, for the things He has done.
full_lyrics:
How can I say thanks for the things You have done for me
Things so undeserved, yet You gave Your life to prove Your love for me

To God be the glory, to God be the glory
To God be the glory for the things He has done
With His blood He has saved me, with His power He has raised me
To God be the glory for the things He has done.

title: Order My Steps
author: GMWA Women of Worship
lyrics_snippet: Order my steps in Your word, dear Lord, lead me, guide me every day.
full_lyrics:
Order my steps in Your word, dear Lord
Lead me, guide me every day
Send Your anointing, Father I pray
Order my steps in Your word

Humbly I ask Thee, teach me Your will
While You are working, help me be still
Satan is busy, but You are real
Order my steps in Your word.

title: Let the Church Say Amen
author: Andraé Crouch
lyrics_snippet: Let the church say amen, God has spoken, let the church say amen.
full_lyrics:
Let the church say amen
Let the church say amen
God has spoken, let the church say amen

Make it your response, whatever He says to you
Trust Him and believe, He will see it through
Let the church say amen.

title: Moving Forward
author: Israel Houghton
lyrics_snippet: I'm not backing up, I'm forgetting what's behind me, I'm pressing toward the mark.
full_lyrics:
I am not backing up, I am forgetting what's behind me
I am pressing toward the mark of a higher calling

You make all things new, yes You make all things new
I'm moving forward to see what You will do
I'm moving forward.

title: You Are Good
author: Israel & New Breed
lyrics_snippet: Lord, You are good and Your mercy endureth forever, people from every nation and tongue.
full_lyrics:
Lord, You are good and Your mercy endureth forever
Lord, You are good and Your mercy endureth forever

People from every nation and tongue
From generation to generation
We worship You, Hallelujah, Hallelujah
We worship You for who You are, for You are good.

title: Alpha and Omega
author: Israel & New Breed
lyrics_snippet: We give You all the glory, we worship You our Lord, You are worthy to be praised.
full_lyrics:
You are Alpha and Omega
We worship You our Lord
You are worthy to be praised

We give You all the glory
We worship You our Lord
You are worthy to be praised
Alpha, Omega, the beginning and the end.

title: Lord You Are Awesome
author: William Murphy
lyrics_snippet: Lord, You are awesome, You rescued me when I was down.
full_lyrics:
Lord, You are awesome
Lord, You are awesome
You rescued me when I was down
And You placed my feet on solid ground

If it had not been for Your love
Where would I be today?
Lord, You are awesome.

title: Turning Around For Me
author: VaShawn Mitchell
lyrics_snippet: All things are working for my good, it's turning around for me.
full_lyrics:
I know it's hard to see it right now
With tears falling from your eyes
But God is working behind the scenes

It's turning around for me
It's turning around for me
All things are working for my good
It's turning around for me.

title: Nobody Greater
author: VaShawn Mitchell
lyrics_snippet: I searched all over, couldn't find nobody, nobody greater than You.
full_lyrics:
I searched all over, couldn't find nobody
I looked high and low, still couldn't find nobody
Nobody greater, nobody greater than You

Your name is above all names
Worthy of all our praise
And nobody greater, nobody greater than You.

title: Awesome
author: Charles Jenkins & Fellowship Chicago
lyrics_snippet: My God is awesome, He can move mountains, keep me in the valley, hide me from the rain.
full_lyrics:
My God is awesome, He can move mountains
Keep me in the valley, hide me from the rain
My God is awesome, heals me when I'm broken
Strength where I've been weakened, forever He shall reign

Awesome, Awesome
Awesome, Awesome
My God is awesome!

title: Worthy Is the Lamb
author: Darlene Zschech
lyrics_snippet: Thank You for the cross, Lord, thank You for the price You paid.
full_lyrics:
Thank You for the cross, Lord
Thank You for the price You paid
Bearing all my sin and shame
In love You came and gave amazing grace

Worthy is the Lamb
Seated on the throne
Crown You with many crowns
You reign victorious forever.

title: Grateful
author: Hezekiah Walker
lyrics_snippet: I am grateful for the things that You have done, yes I'm grateful for the victories we've won.
full_lyrics:
I am grateful for the things that You have done
Yes, I'm grateful for the victories we've won
I could go on and on about Your love

Because I'm grateful, grateful, grateful
Just to praise You Lord
Flowing from my heart are the issues of my heart
Is gratefulness.

title: I Smile
author: Kirk Franklin
lyrics_snippet: I smile, even though I hurt see I smile, I think God for my smile.
full_lyrics:
I dedication my life to You
No matter what I go through
I will look up and smile

I smile, even though I hurt see I smile
I think God for my smile, smile
It's a beautiful day because He keeps me
So I smile.

title: Better
author: Hezekiah Walker
lyrics_snippet: God is going to make it better, He's making it better for you.
full_lyrics:
I know you've been crying, I know you've been hurting
But God is not done yet
He's working it out for you

God is going to make it better
He's making it better for you
Just hold on, don't give up
It's going to get better.

title: God Is
author: James Cleveland
lyrics_snippet: God is my protection, God is my all in all.
full_lyrics:
God is my protection
God is my all in all
God is my light in darkness
He will never let me fall

He is the joy of my salvation
He is my rock, my fortress
God is my everything
Yes, God is.
